nodes.label: Palette Decision: Kit Anatomy + Modern Token Colors
nodes.rationale: Spec finding: kit anatomy was broken but colors were already correct. Adopt kit structure/anatomy with EXISTING modern Discord token colors; do NOT adopt kit's 2021 palette (#3BA55C/#4F545C/#ED4245/#202225). Primary blurple already matches. User declined to override; controller applied recommended defaults.
nodes.norm_label: palette decision: kit anatomy + modern token colors

nodes.label: Sizing Decision: Scale Kit Geometry to Real Discord Sizes
nodes.rationale: Kit's literal geometry (9.5px text, 2px radius) is too small for a real app; scale kit proportions to real Discord app sizes (button text 14px, radius 3px, heights ~32/38/44).
nodes.norm_label: sizing decision: scale kit geometry to real discord sizes

nodes.label: A11y Focus-Visible Outline Standard
nodes.rationale: Every interactive primitive gets :focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px }. Applied to DButton; to be baked into DInput/DTextarea/DTooltip-trigger and future primitives.

nodes.label: W1 Shell Extraction (Extract-via-Props)
nodes.rationale: Extract shell components from the ChatApp monster-file via props/emits with no logic moves — all logic stays in ChatApp. Risky refactor, recommended in a fresh session. Reduced ChatApp.vue from 2221 to 2029 lines.

nodes.label: Unified DM/Group Conversation List Model
nodes.rationale: A group DM is a normal direct-message chat with more than two people, not a server channel. The previous channel-style model (separate 'Group DMs' sidebar section, distinct view==='group') was the wrong model; groups merge into the Direct Messages list sorted by most recent activity (lastMessageAt) and open like a DM with extra affordances (member panel, rename+avatar, invite flow).

nodes.label: Theme Sharing (Code + Link, Preview/Revert)
nodes.rationale: Invite-like point-to-point theme sharing: transport is both a code string (sykord-theme:<base64url JSON>) and a backend link (code first, link in Phase C); surfaced via a settings paste box AND in-chat theme cards. Preview-then-keep/revert lets users try a theme live without persisting; parseTheme never throws and ignores unknown keys. Galleries/discovery and saved-theme libraries are explicitly out of scope.

nodes.label: Visual Density Full Discord Parity
nodes.rationale: Locked decision: full Discord parity including an interface Zoom slider (50-200) and a real Compact message layout (msgLayout cozy/compact). The old conflated 'Message Density' cards are removed; density is repurposed as UI Density (Default/Compact/Spacious).

nodes.label: POST /voice/token Endpoint
nodes.rationale: Auth-required endpoint with membership check (group: Conversation.members; dm: friend/DM validation, room dm:<sortedPair> so both sides share one room). Token generation is local JWT signing (no network), so it works regardless of where the backend runs; the client LiveKit URL comes from server env LIVEKIT_URL so identical code runs on Windows dev and the VPS.

nodes.label: Self-Hosted LiveKit Server
nodes.rationale: Self-hosted at ws://185.231.112.42:7880 (dev) / future wss://livekit.skycord.xyz. Scope locked to DM + group DM calls (server voice channels stay mock); audio first, video + screenshare in Phase 2.
